Adverbials of purpose with to / in order: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。

to + base verb is the most common|in order to emphasizes purpose|so as to / in order to can be placed at the start|so that + subject + can/may + base verb|in order not to / so as not to express a negative purpose
I got up early to catch the first bus.
column3: 我早起是为了赶上头班车。

# title: I got up early _____ the first bus.
column4: 考查to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。此处应为 to catch。句意:我早起是为了赶上头班车。

Adverbials of purpose with to / in order: She studies hard in order that to go to college.|She studies hard for go to college.|She studies hard so as go to college.|She studies hard in order to go to college.
column4: to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。正确句:She studies hard in order to go to college.
